title: Rebuy - Shopify AI personalization and Smart Cart platform
clean_text: Rebuy is a Shopify-native personalization platform offering Smart Cart, a fully customizable flyout cart replacing the default theme cart, alongside AI-powered product recommendations, dynamic bundles, search, and post-purchase upsells. Core packages are sold modularly: Cart & Merchandising, Checkout & Post-Purchase, Search & Collections, and Flows & A/B Testing. Includes a Rules Engine for recommendation logic and a guaranteed positive ROI policy comparing platform spend against Rebuy-attributed revenue. Targets Shopify and Shopify Plus brands seeking a no-code to low-code personalization solution across the full purchase journey.
